paper_title: Few-shot Hate Speech Detection Based on the MindSpore Framework
caption: Ablation study on the HateXplain dataset. The line chart illustrates variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants of MS-FSLHate.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates an ablation study on the HateXplain dataset, showcasing the variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants. The y-axis is labeled "Metric (%)", has a linear scale, and a value range of approximately 56 to 66, with tick labels at every 2 units, starting from 56. The x-axis lists model variants as categorical labels: Full model (Ours), w/o Prompt, w/o Augmentation, w/o Attention, and w/o Prompt & Augmentation. The plot contains three lines: purple for Precision, blue for Recall, and brown for F1-score, all with circular markers and solid line styles. Starting from the left, the Precision line begins at approximately 65.49%, decreases to 61.06%, then increases to 62.63%, followed by a decline to 59.67%, and ends at 65.44%. The Recall line starts at about 65.78%, drops to 60.16%, then rises to 63.17%, declines to 59.17%, and ends at 56.82%. The F1-score line begins at around 65.56%, decreases to 59.64%, then increases to 62.22%, followed by a decline to 57.74%, with no visible marker at the end.
